CapabilityExecution.description:
Host execution transport, explicitly selected before a capability is published.
宿主执行传输，在能力发布前显式选择。

oneOf.description:
Short cooperative Rust callback executed on the owning VM thread.
在所属 VM 线程执行的短时协作 Rust 回调。

Reliable request consumed and completed by an SDK event pump.
由 SDK 事件泵消费并完成的可靠请求。

CapabilityScope.description:
Scope required from the trusted caller, independent from Lua business arguments.
可信调用方必须具备的作用域，独立于 Lua 业务参数。

oneOf.description:
Available during an ordinary operation or session invocation.
在普通操作或会话调用期间可用。

Requires an explicitly bound session identity.
要求显式绑定的会话身份。

ExecutionBackend.description:
Declared backend; unavailable variants are rejected instead of downgraded.
声明的执行后端；不可用的取值直接拒绝，不降级。

oneOf.description:
Execute in owned Lua VMs inside the current host process.
在当前宿主进程内的受管 Lua VM 中执行。

Reserved protocol identity; no worker backend is advertised yet.
预留的协议身份；目前尚未声明工作进程后端可用。

HookCapability.description:
Declares one capability a hook may request from the host.
声明 hook 可向宿主请求的一项能力。

oneOf.description:
Read visible conversation history.
读取可见会话历史。

Read filtered conversation history prepared for extensions.
读取为扩展准备的过滤后会话历史。

Read internal conversation history when explicitly granted.
在明确授权后读取内部会话历史。

Read project and session configuration.
读取项目和会话配置。

Write project or session configuration.
写入项目或会话配置。

Submit context injection operations.
提交上下文注入操作。

Read summarized tool arguments and results.
读取工具参数和结果摘要。

Read full tool arguments and results.
读取完整工具参数和结果。

Use plugin-scoped persistent storage.
使用插件作用域持久化存储。

Use outbound network access.
使用出站网络访问。

HookFailurePolicy.description:
Describes how dispatch should react when one hook fails.
描述单个 hook 失败时调度器应如何响应。

oneOf.description:
Record the failure and continue running later hooks.
记录失败并继续运行后续 hook。

Stop dispatch and return the failure to the caller.
停止调度并把失败返回给调用方。

Record the failure as queueable work and continue running later hooks.
将失败记录为可入队工作并继续运行后续 hook。

HookMode.description:
Describes the behavior class expected from a hook point.
描述 hook 点位期望的行为类别。

oneOf.description:
Observes a runtime event without changing the payload or control flow.
观察运行时事件，不修改 payload 或控制流。

May return a payload replacement or additive runtime operations.
可以返回 payload 替换或追加运行时操作。

May allow, block, or defer a runtime operation.
可以允许、阻断或延迟运行时操作。

Runs side effects such as indexing, memory writeback, or logging.
运行索引、记忆写回或日志记录等副作用。

HookScope.description:
Describes the configuration layer that owns a hook registration.
描述拥有某个 hook 注册项的配置层级。

oneOf.description:
Registration applies to the whole application.
注册项应用于整个应用。

Registration applies to one workspace.
注册项应用于单个工作区。

Registration applies to one project.
注册项应用于单个项目。

Registration applies to one session.
注册项应用于单个会话。

VulcanPluginActionCaller.description:
Authorized caller class for one plugin action.
单个插件 action 的授权调用方类别。

oneOf.description:
The plugin's own Lua bundle may invoke the action.
插件自身 Lua bundle 可以调用 action。

The plugin's mounted WebUI component may invoke the action.
插件挂载的 WebUI 组件可以调用 action。

The host lifecycle state machine may invoke the action.
宿主生命周期状态机可以调用 action。

VulcanPluginActionEffect.description:
Manifest authority for query sharing versus explicitly submitted effects.
清单对查询共享及显式提交操作的权威分类。

oneOf.description:
A local read that may share an identical in-flight request.
可共享相同在途请求的本地只读操作。

A write or externally consuming request; never deduplicated or replayed automatically.
写操作或消耗外部资源的请求；不自动去重或重放。

VulcanPluginActionManifest.description:
One plugin business action callable through the generic service boundary.
一个可通过通用服务边界调用的插件业务 action。

callers.description:
Explicit caller classes allowed to invoke this action.
允许调用当前 action 的显式调用方类别。

effect.description:
Explicit semantic effect; names never determine replay or query policy.
明确的语义效果；不得根据名称判断重放或查询策略。

function.description:
Exact Lua bundle function invoked for this action.
当前 action 调用的精确 Lua bundle 函数。

id.description:
Stable plugin-local action identifier.
稳定的插件内 action 标识。

input_schema_file.description:
Optional package-relative JSON Schema for action input.
可选的插件包相对 action 输入 JSON Schema。

output_schema_file.description:
Optional package-relative JSON Schema for action output.
可选的插件包相对 action 输出 JSON Schema。

result_cache_ms.description:
Allowed lifetime for non-secret read projections; zero permits in-flight sharing only.
非敏感只读投影允许保留的时长；零表示仅共享在途请求。

snapshot_time_arguments.description:
Top-level query arguments whose explicit null means freeze the current Unix millisecond time.
明确空值表示冻结当前 Unix 毫秒时间的顶层查询参数。

timeout_ms.description:
Hard action execution timeout in milliseconds.
action 执行硬超时毫秒数。

VulcanPluginBinaryManifest.description:
One logical native executable with package-relative target mappings.
一个带有插件包相对目标映射的逻辑原生可执行文件。

allow_workspace_cwd.description:
Whether this binary may run in a caller workspace directory captured by the trusted bridge.
此二进制是否可以在可信桥接层捕获的调用方工作区目录内运行。

allowed_env.description:
Environment variable names that plugin calls may set for this executable.
插件调用此可执行文件时允许设置的环境变量名。

id.description:
Stable plugin-local executable identifier.
稳定的插件内可执行文件标识。

targets.description:
Package-relative executable paths keyed by exact Rust target triple.
以精确 Rust 目标三元组为键的插件包相对可执行文件路径。

VulcanPluginCapacityPurpose.description:
Host-selected execution purpose; plugin business arguments cannot select capacity ownership.
宿主选择的执行用途；插件业务参数不能选择容量归属。

oneOf.description:
Ordinary tool invocations keep their declared single-call semantics.
普通工具调用保留声明的单次调用语义。

Controller-owned tool sessions retain one exact VM for their lifetime.
控制器拥有的工具会话在整个寿命内保留一个精确 VM。

Persistent Hook instances preserve their ordering and original shutdown declaration.
持久 Hook 实例保留顺序及原关闭声明。

Transient and persistent UI Actions share limits without sharing Lua state.
瞬时及持久 UI Action 共享上限，不共享 Lua 状态。

Host lifecycle callbacks retain their own capacity across catalog generations.
宿主生命周期回调跨目录代次保留自身容量。

Activation probes consume real initialization resources without a business export.
启用探测消费真实初始化资源，不具有业务导出。

VulcanPluginCapacityRequirement.description:
Minimum host policy needed by one execution purpose, separate from current free capacity.
单个执行用途所需的最小宿主策略，独立于当前空闲容量。

purpose.description:
Exact production purpose whose frozen configuration must satisfy these floors.
冻结配置必须满足这些下限的精确生产用途。

queued_bytes.description:
Minimum acceptable pending-input byte limit, positive and never interpreted as unlimited.
可接受的最小等待输入字节上限，必须为正，绝不解释为无限。

queued_calls.description:
Minimum acceptable pending-call limit, positive and never interpreted as unlimited.
可接受的最小等待调用上限，必须为正，绝不解释为无限。

reserved_resident_vms.description:
Required non-lendable guarantee; zero requires no reservation or prewarming.
必需的不可出借保证；零表示不要求预留或预热。

resident_vms.description:
Minimum acceptable resident limit, positive and not a request to allocate instances.
可接受的最小常驻上限，必须为正，且不表示申请分配实例。

running_calls.description:
Minimum acceptable running-call limit, positive and bounded by resident_vms.
可接受的最小执行调用上限，必须为正且不超过 resident_vms。

VulcanPluginConfigManifest.description:
Plugin-owned configuration schema and defaults.
插件持有的配置 Schema 与默认值。

defaults_file.description:
Package-relative JSON file containing default configuration.
包含默认配置的插件包相对 JSON 文件。

schema_file.description:
Package-relative JSON Schema for the complete configuration object.
完整配置对象使用的插件包相对 JSON Schema。

VulcanPluginDependenciesManifest.description:
Dependency declaration for one plugin-private execution environment.
单个插件私有执行环境的依赖声明。

install_mode.description:
Whether dependencies come from bundled assets or an approved registry.
依赖来自随包资产还是经授权的注册表。

manifest.description:
Package-relative dependency manifest consumed by the managed runtime installer.
由受管运行时安装器消费的插件包相对依赖清单。

VulcanPluginDependencyInstallMode.description:
Supported dependency acquisition modes.
支持的依赖获取模式。

oneOf.description:
Install exclusively from artifacts shipped inside the plugin package.
仅从插件包内随附的制品安装。

Install from a registry after explicit network authorization.
在获得明确网络授权后从注册表安装。

VulcanPluginDisplayManifest.description:
Default user-facing plugin metadata.
默认的用户可见插件元数据。

capability.description:
Default concise capability description.
默认的简洁能力描述。

name.description:
Default plugin name.
默认插件名称。

VulcanPluginExecutionManifest.description:
Host-managed execution resources shared by Lua and MCP protocols.
由 Lua 与 MCP 协议共享的宿主管理执行资源。

dependencies.description:
Dependency graph and acquisition policy for the private plugin environment.
插件私有环境的依赖图与获取策略。

native_binaries.description:
Logical native executable resources resolved by the Vulcan host.
由 Vulcan 宿主解析的逻辑原生可执行资源。

node_entries.description:
Logical Node.js entries resolved through the managed runtime distribution.
通过受管运行时发行版解析的逻辑 Node.js 入口。

python_entries.description:
Logical Python entries resolved through the managed runtime distribution.
通过受管运行时发行版解析的逻辑 Python 入口。

VulcanPluginHookManifest.description:
One Lua handler bound to an existing host-owned hook point.
绑定到现有宿主自有 hook 点位的单个 Lua 处理器。

display_name.description:
Optional user-facing handler label.
可选的用户可见处理器标签。

failure_policy.description:
Failure behavior delegated to the existing hook dispatcher.
委托给现有 hook 调度器的失败处理行为。

function.description:
Lua module function that receives the exact serialized invocation frame.
接收精确序列化调用帧的 Lua 模块函数。

id.description:
Stable hook identifier within the owning plugin.
所属插件内部稳定的 hook 标识。

mode.description:
Existing host hook behavior mode used for result aggregation.
结果聚合所使用的现有宿主 hook 行为模式。

point.description:
Exact host hook point subscribed by this handler.
该处理器订阅的精确宿主 hook 点位。

priority.description:
Lower priority values execute before larger values.
优先级数值越低越早执行。

progress_label.description:
Optional progress label for blocking preflight execution.
阻塞式前置执行使用的可选进度标签。

requested_capabilities.description:
Host capabilities requested by the handler.
处理器请求的宿主能力集合。

scope.description:
Configuration scope projected into the host registration.
投影到宿主注册项的配置作用域。

timeout_ms.description:
Host-side execution timeout in milliseconds.
宿主侧执行超时时间，单位毫秒。

tool_target.description:
Exact original tool identity required by the three generic tool hook points.
三个通用工具 Hook 点位必须声明的原始工具精确身份。

VulcanPluginHostCapabilityRequirement.description:
One required registered host contract, independent from permission grants or external service readiness.
单个必需的已注册宿主契约，独立于权限授予或外部服务就绪状态。

execution.description:
Declared core dispatch transport, checked against the actual captured descriptor.
声明的核心分发传输，针对实际捕获描述符校验。

name.description:
Exact namespaced callback name; aliases and alternate names are never probed.
精确命名空间回调名称；绝不探测别名或备用名称。

scope.description:
Required trusted caller scope, independently enforced by core invocation admission.
必需的可信调用方作用域，由核心调用入场独立执行。

version.description:
Exact semantic interface version; a range or a newer version does not implicitly match.
精确语义接口版本；版本范围或更新版本不隐式匹配。

VulcanPluginLifecycleManifest.description:
Optional Lua lifecycle function declarations.
可选 Lua 生命周期函数声明。

disable.description:
Function invoked while a plugin is being disabled.
插件停用过程中调用的函数。

enable.description:
Function invoked before a plugin becomes enabled.
插件进入启用状态前调用的函数。

install.description:
Function invoked after a user plugin package is installed.
用户插件包安装完成后调用的函数。

uninstall.description:
Function invoked before a user plugin package is removed.
用户插件包移除前调用的函数。

VulcanPluginLuaRuntimeManifest.description:
Optional managed Lua protocol implemented by one plugin bundle.
由单个插件 bundle 实现的可选受管 Lua 协议。

actions.description:
Host-callable plugin business actions implemented by Lua functions.
由 Lua 函数实现且可由宿主调用的插件业务 action 集合。

bundle.description:
Package-relative bundled Lua source loaded through the fixed Vulcan bridge package.
通过固定 Vulcan 桥接包加载的插件包相对 Lua bundle 源文件。

hook_shutdown_function.description:
Optional Lua function invoked before closing the persistent hook lease.
关闭持久 hook 租约前调用的可选 Lua 函数。

hooks.description:
Lua hook handlers registered into host-owned hook points.
注册到宿主自有 hook 点位的 Lua hook 处理器。

invoke_function.description:
Lua function used for normal operations.
常规操作使用的 Lua 函数。

lifecycle.description:
Lifecycle callbacks exported by the Lua bundle.
Lua bundle 导出的生命周期回调。

lua_modules.description:
Host-allowlisted Lua modules exposed through the restricted plugin runtime API.
通过受限插件运行时 API 暴露的宿主白名单 Lua 模块。

max_active_sessions.description:
Hard upper bound for concurrently active sessions.
并发活动会话的硬上限。

session_idle_timeout_sec.description:
Optional idle timeout that triggers host-owned session cleanup.
触发宿主自有会话清理的可选空闲超时秒数。

shutdown_function.description:
Lua function used before closing a session lease.
关闭会话租约前使用的 Lua 函数。

tools.description:
Atomic provider-visible Lua tool group.
原子化的 Provider 可见 Lua 工具组。

VulcanPluginMcpManifest.description:
Model Context Protocol servers contributed by one plugin.
单个插件贡献的模型上下文协议服务器集合。

servers.description:
Independently managed servers keyed by their plugin-local identifiers.
以插件内标识独立管理的服务器集合。

VulcanPluginMcpOAuthManifest.description:
Host-driven OAuth settings for one plugin-owned remote MCP server.
单个插件自有远端 MCP 服务器的宿主驱动 OAuth 设置。

client_id.description:
Optional pre-registered client identifier.
可选的预注册客户端标识。

client_secret.description:
Optional pre-registered client secret from the host Secret Store.
可选的宿主 Secret Store 预注册客户端密钥。

redirect_uri.description:
Optional exact redirect URI.
可选的精确回调 URI。

scopes.description:
Ordered OAuth scopes requested during authorization.
授权期间请求的有序 OAuth scope 集合。

VulcanPluginMcpScopeManifest.description:
Lifetime of one plugin-owned MCP server declaration.
单个插件自有 MCP 服务器声明的生命周期。

oneOf.description:
Start with the enabled plugin's global MCP runtime partition.
随已启用插件的全局 MCP 运行时分区启动。

Start only for one trusted conversation after a Core-owned grant is issued.
仅在 Core 为某个可信会话颁发授权后启动。

VulcanPluginMcpServerManifest.description:
One plugin-owned Model Context Protocol server.
单个插件自有的模型上下文协议服务器。

id.description:
Stable server identifier within the owning plugin.
所属插件内部稳定的服务器标识。

name.description:
Default user-facing server name.
默认的用户可见服务器名称。

scope.description:

当前服务器选择的启动生命周期；会话服务器要求所有者授权。

transport.description:
Strictly selected transport and its transport-specific settings.
严格选择的传输方式及其专属设置。

VulcanPluginMcpStdioLauncherManifest.description:
Managed local launcher variants accepted by plugin MCP stdio servers.
插件 MCP stdio 服务器允许使用的受管本地启动器变体。

oneOf.description:
Execute a declared Node.js module through the managed Node runtime.
通过受管 Node 运行时执行已声明的 Node.js 模块。

entry_id.description:
Identifier from `execution.node_entries`.
来自 `execution.node_entries` 的标识。

oneOf.description:
Execute one exact package bin from the plugin-private dependency environment.
从插件私有依赖环境执行一个精确的 package bin。

bin.description:
Exact bin key declared by the installed package.
已安装依赖包声明的精确 bin 键。

package.description:
Exact dependency package name.
精确依赖包名称。

oneOf.description:
Execute a declared native binary directly without a Shell.
不经 Shell 直接执行已声明的原生二进制文件。

binary_id.description:
Identifier from `execution.native_binaries`.
来自 `execution.native_binaries` 的标识。

VulcanPluginMcpTransportManifest.description:
Transport-specific settings for one plugin MCP server.
单个插件 MCP 服务器的传输专属设置。

oneOf.description:
Local stdio transport launched through a manifest-owned managed entry.
通过清单自有受管入口启动的本地 stdio 传输。

args.description:
Ordered launcher arguments resolved from explicit value sources.
从显式值来源解析的有序启动参数。

env.description:
Child environment values keyed by exact variable name.
以精确变量名为键的子进程环境变量值。

launcher.description:
Managed launcher resolved without Shell or PATH lookup.
不经 Shell 或 PATH 查找解析的受管启动器。

oneOf.description:
Streamable HTTP transport connected to an explicit remote endpoint.
连接到显式远程端点的 Streamable HTTP 传输。

headers.description:
Request headers keyed by exact header name.
以精确 Header 名称为键的请求 Header。

oauth.description:
Optional host-driven OAuth client settings.
可选的宿主驱动 OAuth 客户端设置。

url.description:
Remote endpoint resolved from one typed value source.
从唯一带类型值来源解析的远程端点。

Legacy Server-Sent Events transport connected to an explicit endpoint.
连接到显式端点的旧式服务器发送事件传输。

headers.description:
Request headers keyed by exact header name.
以精确 Header 名称为键的请求 Header。

url.description:
Remote endpoint resolved from one typed value source.
从唯一带类型值来源解析的远程端点。

单个由插件包持有的逻辑 Node.js 脚本入口。

插件包相对工作目录。

file.description:

插件包相对 JavaScript 模块文件。

稳定的插件内 Node 入口标识。

VulcanPluginPermission.description:
Host permission that must be declared and authorized before use.
使用前必须声明并授权的宿主权限。

oneOf.description:
Access host-allowlisted Lua runtime modules declared by this bundled plugin.
访问当前内建插件声明且经宿主白名单允许的 Lua 运行时模块。

Perform HTTPS requests through an explicitly declared runtime network client.
通过显式声明的运行时网络客户端执行 HTTPS 请求。

目标平台可用性声明。

id.description:

插件内部稳定的贡献标识。

required_tools.description:

VulcanPluginPythonEntryManifest.description:
One logical Python script entry owned by a plugin package.
单个由插件包持有的逻辑 Python 脚本入口。

Stable plugin-local Python entry identifier.
稳定的插件内 Python 入口标识。

VulcanPluginReusableToolManifest.description:
Opt-in module contract; callbacks must clear request state and confirm reuse before another request runs.
主动声明的模块契约；回调必须清除请求状态，并在其他请求运行前确认可复用。

after_call.description:
Declared module function called with the envelope and business success flag; must return true.
使用信封及业务执行成功标志调用的模块声明函数；必须返回 true。

before_call.description:
Declared module function called with this invocation's envelope before business; must return true.
在业务前使用本次调用信封调用的模块声明函数；必须返回 true。

idle_ttl_ms.description:
Positive idle duration before retirement; pool metadata is retired after its users leave too.
退役前的正数空闲时长；用户离开后池元数据也会退役。

initialization_capabilities.description:
Exact host callbacks allowed while this reusable module source initializes; omission denies all.
此可复用模块源码初始化时允许的精确宿主回调；省略时全部拒绝。
These names narrow existing plugin grants and never authorize additional business capabilities.
这些名称收窄既有插件授权，绝不授权额外业务能力。

max_resident_vms.description:
Requested positive per-domain resident ceiling, required to fit the host purpose policy.
请求的正数域常驻上限，必须满足宿主用途策略。

max_running_calls.description:
Requested positive per-domain running ceiling; key_serial requires exactly one.
请求的正数域执行上限；key_serial 要求恰好为一。

max_uses.description:
Positive successful invocation count before an instance is retired.
实例退役前允许的正数成功调用次数。

ordering.description:
Explicit ordering applies to the same immutable partition, never all plugin conversations implicitly.
显式顺序作用于同一不可变分区，绝不隐式作用于插件全部会话。

reuse_check.description:
Declared argument-free module function called after cleanup; only true permits reuse.
清理后调用的无参数模块声明函数；仅 true 允许复用。

VulcanPluginRuntimeRequirements.description:
Required compatibility and capacity floors; host policy must satisfy these without being rewritten.
必需的兼容性及容量下限；宿主策略必须满足这些条件，且不能被自动改写。

backend.description:
Required execution backend; unsupported backends are rejected without substitution.
必需执行后端；不支持的后端直接拒绝，不替代。

capacities.description:
Distinct purpose requirements; an empty list explicitly requests no additional resource floors.
不重复的用途要求；空列表明确表示不要求额外资源下限。

core_capabilities.description:
Exact versioned semantic feature names advertised by the linked core, never permission grants.
链接核心声明的精确版本化语义功能名，绝不表示权限授予。

host_capabilities.description:
Exact registered host contracts required for business admission; omission declares no callback requirement.
业务入场所需的精确已注册宿主契约；省略表示不声明回调要求。

protocol_version.description:
Exact embedded core protocol identity, independent from the package manifest version.
精确嵌入式核心协议身份，独立于插件包清单版本。

VulcanPluginToolExecutionKind.description:
Supported generic tool execution lifecycle.
支持的通用工具执行生命周期。

oneOf.description:
Create, invoke, and close one temporary managed lease for a single call.
为单次调用创建、执行并关闭一个临时受管租约。

Open and register one owner-bound managed session.
打开并注册一个绑定所有者的受管会话。

Invoke one operation through an existing owner-bound session.
通过已有的所有者绑定会话调用操作。

Close and retire one existing owner-bound session.
关闭并回收一个已有的所有者绑定会话。

VulcanPluginToolExecutionManifest.description:
Runtime dispatch declaration attached to one plugin tool.
附着在单个插件工具上的运行时调度声明。

kind.description:
Generic session lifecycle kind.
通用会话生命周期类型。

max_timeout_ms.description:
Maximum accepted value for the optional timeout argument.
可选超时参数允许的最大值。

operation.description:
Plugin-owned operation name inserted into the exact JSON payload.
插入精确 JSON 载荷的插件自有操作名。

reusable.description:
Explicit version-two reusable instance contract; omission preserves single-call execution.
明确的第二版可复用实例契约；省略保留单次调用执行。

timeout_argument.description:
Optional argument whose value extends the fixed host timeout.
可选参数，其数值会扩展固定宿主超时。

timeout_grace_ms.description:
Grace window added after the selected operation timeout.
选定操作超时后追加的宽限窗口。

timeout_ms.description:
Fixed host timeout when no bounded timeout argument is declared.
未声明有界超时参数时使用的固定宿主超时。

VulcanPluginToolHookSourceKind.description:
Supported source kinds for an explicitly targeted generic tool hook.
显式定向的通用工具 Hook 所支持的来源类别。

oneOf.description:
Host-owned native Rust tool.
宿主自有的 Rust 原生工具。

Host-managed internal runtime tool.
宿主管理的内部运行时工具。

Manifest-driven plugin tool.
清单驱动的插件工具。

LuaSkills runtime tool.
LuaSkills 运行时工具。

Tool discovered from a Model Context Protocol server.
从模型上下文协议服务器发现的工具。

AI-specialized alias backed by a host tool.
由宿主工具承载的 AI 专用别名。

VulcanPluginToolHookTargetManifest.description:
Original source identity matched before the host changes a tool's public name.
宿主改写工具公开名称前用于匹配的原始来源身份。

namespace.description:
Exact source-owned namespace, such as one MCP server identity.
来源持有的精确命名空间，例如一个 MCP 服务器身份。

original_name.description:
Exact source-owned name, never the normalized AI-visible tool name.
来源持有的精确名称，绝非归一化后 AI 可见的工具名称。

source_kind.description:
Exact kind of the original tool source.
原始工具来源的精确类别。

VulcanPluginToolManifest.description:
One provider-visible tool declared by a plugin package.
插件包声明的单个 Provider 可见工具。

available_in_plan.description:
Whether the tool may execute in Plan mode.
工具是否允许在计划模式中执行。

description.description:
English model-visible tool description.
面向模型的英文工具描述。

execution.description:
Generic runtime dispatch declaration.
通用运行时调度声明。

group.description:
Atomic tool group identifier.
原子工具组标识。

id.description:
Stable globally unique tool identifier.
全局唯一的稳定工具标识。

parameters_file.description:
JSON Schema file relative to the package root.
相对于插件包根目录的 JSON Schema 文件。

VulcanPluginToolOrdering.description:
Ordering inside one exact controller, workspace, plugin generation and tool partition.
单个精确控制器、工作区、插件代次及工具分区内的顺序。

oneOf.description:
Serialize calls in admission order inside this exact partition.
在此精确分区内按入场顺序串行化调用。

Permit concurrent independent instances within the host-approved resident and running limits.
在宿主批准的常驻及执行上限内允许独立实例并行。

VulcanPluginUiManifest.description:
Dynamic UI declarations for one plugin.
单个插件的动态 UI 声明。

mounts.description:
Ordered UI mounts contributed by the plugin.
插件贡献的有序 UI 挂载集合。

VulcanPluginUiMountIcon.description:
Stable host-owned icons available to dynamic plugin navigation entries.
动态插件导航条目可使用的稳定宿主图标。

oneOf.description:
Generic plugin puzzle icon.
通用插件拼图图标。

Command-routing icon.
命令路由图标。

Usage statistics chart icon.
用量统计图表图标。

VulcanPluginUiMountKind.description:
How the host turns one mount entry into a page.
宿主将挂载入口转为页面的方式。

oneOf.description:
A plugin-owned ESM factory renders the page with host SDK components.
插件自有 ESM 工厂使用宿主 SDK 组件渲染页面。

The host page kit renders a declarative settings layout.
宿主页面套件渲染声明式设置版面。

VulcanPluginUiMountManifest.description:
One uncompressed ESM module mounted into a host-owned UI location.
一个挂载到宿主持有界面位置的未压缩 ESM 模块。

entry.description:
Package-relative entry: an uncompressed `.mjs` module, or a `.json` settings layout.
插件包相对入口：未压缩 `.mjs` 模块，或 `.json` 设置版面。

export.description:
Named ESM export containing the mount factory; required for modules, forbidden for settings.
包含挂载工厂的 ESM 命名导出；模块必填，设置版面禁止。

icon.description:
Host-owned icon rendered beside the navigation label.
在导航名称旁渲染的宿主持有图标。

id.description:
Stable plugin-local mount identifier.
稳定的插件内挂载标识。

kind.description:
Whether the entry is a plugin-owned ESM module or a host-rendered settings layout.
入口是插件自有 ESM 模块，还是由宿主渲染的设置版面。

label.description:
Default host navigation label for this mount.
此挂载点使用的默认宿主导航名称。

label_message_key.description:
Plugin locale message key overriding the navigation label.
覆盖导航名称的插件语言包消息键。

point.description:
Host-owned mount point.
宿主持有的挂载点。

VulcanPluginUiMountPoint.description:
Stable host-owned dynamic UI mount points.
稳定的宿主持有动态 UI 挂载点。

oneOf.description:
Plugin detail page below the LuaSkills/Plugins area.
LuaSkills/插件区域下的插件详情页。

Main workspace page used by future workflows.
供后续工作流使用的主工作区页面。

Conversation right-side auxiliary panel.
会话右侧辅助面板。

VulcanPluginValueSourceManifest.description:
One unambiguous source for a plugin configuration value.
单个插件配置值的无歧义来源。

oneOf.description:
Inline non-secret value stored in the plugin manifest.
存储在插件清单中的内联非敏感值。

value.description:
Exact literal value.
精确字面值。

oneOf.description:
Reference to one key from the plugin configuration contract.
对插件配置契约中单个键的引用。

key.description:
Exact plugin configuration key.
精确插件配置键。

oneOf.description:
Reference to one host-managed secret scoped to the plugin.
对限定到当前插件的单个宿主管理 Secret 的引用。

key.description:
Exact plugin-scoped secret key.
精确插件作用域 Secret 键。

oneOf.description:
Reference to one explicitly named host environment variable.
对单个显式命名宿主环境变量的引用。

name.description:
Exact environment variable name.
精确环境变量名称。

oneOf.description:
One-use browser-level CDP endpoint issued by Core for this conversation.
Core 针对当前会话颁发的一次性浏览器级 CDP 端点。

description:
One complete Vulcan Plugin package manifest.
一份完整的 Vulcan 插件包清单。

config.description:
Optional plugin configuration contract.
可选插件配置契约。

default_enabled.description:
Whether the plugin is enabled before user overrides are applied.
应用用户覆盖前插件是否默认启用。

display.description:
Default user-facing metadata.
默认的用户可见元数据。

execution.description:
Host-managed execution resources shared by executable plugin protocols.
由可执行插件协议共享的宿主管理执行资源。

id.description:
Stable plugin identifier.
稳定插件标识。

locales.description:
Locale file paths keyed by locale identifier.
以语言标识为键的本地化文件路径。

lua_runtime.description:
Optional managed Lua protocol declaration.
可选的受管 Lua 协议声明。

mcp.description:
Optional Model Context Protocol server declarations.
可选的模型上下文协议服务器声明。

permissions.description:
Explicit host permissions requested by this plugin.
当前插件请求的显式宿主权限集合。

platforms.description:
Platform availability declaration.
平台可用性声明。

prompt_contributions.description:
Prompt contributions activated with their required tools.
随所需工具共同激活的提示词贡献。

required_files.description:
Package-relative regular files required for every enabled plugin component.
每个已启用插件组件都要求存在的插件包相对普通文件集合。

runtime_requirements.description:
Version-two Lua requirements; omission is allowed only for non-Lua or legacy manifests.
第二版 Lua 必需条件；仅非 Lua 或旧版清单允许省略。

schema_version.description:
Manifest schema version.
清单结构版本。

ui.description:
Dynamic WebUI mount declarations.
动态 WebUI 挂载声明。

version.description:
Package semantic version.
插件包语义版本。
